meta.name: openai-docs
meta.description: Use when the user asks how to build with OpenAI products or APIs and needs up-to-date official documentation with citations, help choosing the latest model for a use case, or explicit GPT-5.4 upgrade and prompt-upgrade guidance; prioritize OpenAI docs MCP tools, use bundled references only as helper context, and restrict any fallback browsing to official OpenAI domains.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询 OpenAI 官方文档并获取最新模型推荐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速获取 OpenAI 官方文档和模型升级指导。
copy.tagline_en: Query official OpenAI docs and get latest model recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to OpenAI official docs and model upgrade guidance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会优先从 OpenAI 官方开发者文档中查找答案，并引用来源。它还能帮你选择最新模型、升级到 GPT-5.4 或优化提示词。
howto.when: 当你询问如何使用 OpenAI 产品或 API、需要最新官方文档、选择模型、或要求升级到 GPT-5.4 时触发。

say.text: 如何用 Responses API 构建一个多模态聊天机器人？
say.note: Claude 会搜索并引用 OpenAI 官方文档。

say.text: 帮我升级到 GPT-5.4，并检查提示词是否需要调整。
say.note: Claude 会加载升级指南和提示词指南。

say.text: 目前哪个模型最适合做代码生成？
say.note: Claude 会参考最新模型文档并验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will prioritize searching OpenAI official developer docs for answers and cite sources. It can also help you choose the latest model, upgrade to GPT-5.4, or optimize prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to use OpenAI products or APIs, need up-to-date official docs, choose a model, or request a GPT-5.4 upgrade.

say_en.text: How to build a multimodal chatbot using the Responses API?
say_en.note: Claude will search and cite OpenAI official docs.

say_en.text: Upgrade me to GPT-5.4 and check if prompts need adjustment.
say_en.note: Claude will load upgrade and prompting guides.

say_en.text: Which model is best for code generation right now?
say_en.note: Claude will reference the latest model doc and verify.
